values.meaning: heal to Rakan and nearby allies when the mark completes
delay before the mark completes and heal triggers
values.quote: After 3 seconds or if an allied champion enters the radius

mechanics.claim: The Q deals damage to the first enemy hit by the projectile.
mechanics.quote: slings an enchanted feather in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown does not start on cast but only once the projectile vanishes (hits something or reaches max range).
A mark/heal-trigger radius only forms if the feather hits an enemy champion or epic monster (a target dummy counts as an enemy champion).
mechanics.quote: If the target was an enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}}, a radius is marked around '''Rakan'''

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the projectile's on-hit effect specially but does not prevent the marked healing area from forming.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent the marked area from being formed.

mechanics.claim: The heal can trigger and complete its animation-independent effect immediately after the projectile hits.
mechanics.quote: The heal can activate immediately after the projectile hits the target, before the healing return animation completes.

mechanics.claim: The heal still triggers and affects Rakan even while he is untargetable.
mechanics.quote: The heal will trigger and affect '''Rakan''' even if he is {{tip|untargetable}}.
